ClassName and FieldName are String abbreviations and Class retains an ordered List FieldName. Distinct fields are a well-formed-table convention established in given.programs, rather than a claim that the raw Class constructor enforces it. Empty lists give the zero-field case. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites.
